summary: Iteration 11.5 (iter_12 file) — click->MemoryDrawer happy path is now FULLY VERIFIED end-to-end via the new deterministic test hook. After loading the app on the default NEURAL tab, sending `/spawn first thought` through the terminal (data-testid=chat-input), and waiting 8s for the satellite poll, `typeof window.__althea_pickFirstSatellite === 'function'`. Calling it returned 'NODE-0000' (matches /^NODE-\d+$/), [data-testid=memory-drawer] became visible, and [data-testid=memory-search-input] was pre-populated with the EXACT same id 'NODE-0000'. The drawer's close button (aria-label*=close) dismissed it. Switching to NETWORK tab regressed nothing — 10 SVGs render, ALTHEA text is present in the interaction graph, AND the hook remains defined (`typeof === 'function'`) on the NETWORK tab confirming the visibility-hidden canvas-mount pattern from CenterDeck.jsx works correctly. ZERO pageerrors, zero console errors (only benign WebGL GPU stall warnings). Secondary real-raycaster path: tried 100 mouse.click() points on a 5-ring polar grid (r=120..280 px, every 18°) around the canvas centre with drawer reset between clicks — none landed on a satellite (rotation @ 0.18 rad/s makes deterministic pixel-targeting unreliable). Per the review request that is explicitly Acceptable because the synthetic hook path succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: NeuralCore.jsx lines 220-249: clean pattern — visible 0.14 mesh kept for aesthetics, transparent 0.5-radius picking sphere added as sibling with shared userData reference. Both pushed into latticeMeshes so raycaster.intersectObjects returns the picking sphere preferentially due to its larger silhouette. Good.

window.__althea_pickFirstSatellite (lines 319-326) finds the first mesh with userData.nodeId (skips picking spheres if they didn't share userData, but they do via reference). Returns null if no satellites yet, which is correct for the >6s poll race window.

Hook cleanup on unmount is implied by the useEffect's cleanup (it should `delete window.__althea_pickFirstSatellite` in cleanup to be tidy — currently inspecting the file shows the hook is set inside the scene-init useEffect; recommend adding `delete window.__althea_pickFirstSatellite;` to the cleanup function for hygiene, though there's only one mount so the practical impact is nil).

Secondary real-click reliability remains poor for automated tests due to continuous group.rotation.y = t*0.18; this is fine because the deterministic hook covers E2E. For human UX consider pausing rotation on canvas hover.
